title: A List-Id rule of your own labels a newsletter News (fake data)
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData and open Settings › Importance & labels › Rules
Click Add rule…, name it, choose The List-Id contains and type a newsletter's list domain, choose Label News, Save
Open Settings › General › Auto labels and click Classify recent mail, then look at that newsletter's row
expected: The rule shows under Your rules as “When the List-Id contains … → News” with a switch, Up, Down, Edit and Delete. The newsletter's chip says News. On real accounts the List-Id is not known yet in this build, so such a rule matches nothing there.
